claim_boundary: For this exact source-pinned six-state PRISM robot IMDP and the protected goal1 max-min/max-max reachability family, exhaustive enumeration of all 52 target-respecting partitions proves the unique coarsest preserving quotient has four classes: {s0,s1}, {s2,s3}, {s4}, {s5}. All 16 target-respecting partitions with fewer than four classes were tested and rejected. This is a finite bounded minimality result, not a scalable universal quotient algorithm or a general probabilistic bisimulation theorem.
